response.description:
In
late September 2026, the following updates and
enhancements were made to Azure SQL Managed Instance:  
 Use
     the flexible memory feature in Azure SQL Managed Instance to change the
     amount of memory allocated to your SQL managed instance without changing
     the number of vCores.  
 Get
     support for higher transaction log write throughput limits in Azure SQL
     Managed Instance Business Critical, enabling greater performance for
     write-intensive workloads.  Learn more: Flexible Memory in Azure SQL Managed
Instance Azure SQL Managed Instance
Business Critical
response.title: Generally Available: Azure SQL Managed Instance updates for late-September 2026
